title: Sovereign Kingdom & Empire
body: Macro-political realm sheet covering crown succession, noble houses, provinces, standing armies, treaties, and internal crises.

sampleValues.Realm Name & Heraldry: The Marches of Valenmere (Silver Stag on Deep Plum)
sampleValues.Current Monarch & Succession Law: Queen Isolde IV; crown passes to whichever royal heir survives the Winter Crossing pilgrimage.
sampleValues.Capital & Crown Lands: Vaelor's Reach and the Salt Terraces
sampleValues.Major Provinces & Noble Houses:
High Pine | House Corvus | Timber & bowyers (wavering)
Ashen Coast | House Haldor | Salt mines & galleys (loyal)
sampleValues.Armed Forces, Fleet & Alliances: Three Stormwatch naval squadrons and 6,000 pike-levies; bound by grain treaty with the Ash-Wind Riders.
sampleValues.Impending Crises & Pretenders: Prince Alaric claims the last Winter Crossing was rigged and is rallying debt-ridden border barons.
